freeze_gate: all base campaign IDs are registered before labels are released
ordering: ascending SHA-256 of UTF-8 assignment_seed || ':' || base_campaign_id within each stratum
replay_inheritance: every RP0-RP7 replay child, EpisodeRevision, and terminal AssemblyOutcome inherits its base campaign partition and bootstrap_cluster_id

physical_outage_population.relationship_to_base_runs: independent dedicated cohort, not a descendant of the 220 base runs
physical_outage_population.fitting_prohibition: PO1 traces cannot enter training, development, calibration, RT2, RT3a, or RT3b

fail_closed_rules: a row with a missing registry column cannot enter a formal result
one base_campaign_id cannot map to more than one partition
a replay-descendant partition mismatch invalidates the complete base campaign cluster
every complete 10-run base stratum contributes at least one campaign to every partition
every PO1 row has partition=locked_test, bootstrap_cluster_id=po1_cell_id, and no parent base run
locked_test rows cannot be reassigned after label release
